And I say to you
Whoever puts away his wife for any other cause than the loss of her virtue
and takes another
is a false husband: and he who takes her as his wife when she is put away
is no true husband to her.

正是这样的人。」

and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
